description: Charlotte, NC – Former business executive, lawyer and candidate for State Senate District 42, Stacie McGinn, solidifies her strong position to defeat Democrat Woodson Bradley, reporting $275,000 in cash on hand at the end of the quarter, compared with $240,000 for Bradley.
paid_for_by: PAID FOR BY STACIE MCGINN FOR NC SENATE bottom of page
title: NC Senate Candidate Stacie McGinn Reports $275,000 in Cash on Hand as of June 30th, Outperforming Her Opponent Woodson Bradley
